about: The postcommunio of the formulary “Epiphany of the Lord” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Grant, we beseech Thee, almighty God, that with a purified mind we may understand those things which we celebrate with solemn rite. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.
